description.text: The eleventh expansion of the Sun & Moon series, released on 31 May 2019 as the first expansion of Japan's Reiwa era. Mewtwo & Mew-GX leads it: its Ability lets it use the attacks of any Pokémon-GX on its player's Bench or in the discard pile. Slowpoke & Psyduck-GX and Mega Sableye & Tyranitar-GX are its other TAG TEAMs, with Latios-GX, a card aimed at TAG TEAMs, Dragonite-GX and Aerodactyl-GX, and Supporters such as Blue's Tactics and Misty's Favor. Two Starter Sets led by the TAG TEAMs Espeon & Deoxys-GX and Umbreon & Darkrai-GX came out the same day. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 94, ending with four Trainer Rare cards marked TR, followed by full-art Super Rare cards, the TAG TEAMs in two versions each, rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon-GX, and gold Ultra Rare Cherish Ball, Giant Bomb and Weakness Guard Energy. In English many of its cards came out in Unified Minds in August 2019.
